remaining_gaps: Current legal predicate and coverage through 2026-10-14 require judgment; a citation or 1989 snapshot cannot prove continuation.
Current-law lead lacks an original-source sha256.

Sections 1-501, 1-502 and 1-503 (each agency's draft consumer program within 60 days of the order, revised program within 30 days after the comment period, final publication within 90 days and effect within 30 days after publication) are dated one-time commands to every agency. The packet holds no source showing, for the agencies concerned, whether and when these programs were published and took effect, and a due date is a deadline, not an end, so neither a terminated state with a dated end nor an operative state can be supported. Source needed: the Federal Register final consumer-program notices of the agencies (1980 and later) or a held source showing completion.

No held source shows whether the Consumer Affairs Council itself met or continued after the early 1980s; the April 6, 2026 HUD notice (91 FR 17295, FR Doc. 2026-06609) cites Executive Order 12160 as authority for a consumer-contact system, which supports the order's continuing force but not the Council's clauses.
